headword: {炭素排出|たんそはいしゅつ}

definitions.explanation: The release of carbon dioxide and other carbon compounds into the atmosphere, especially from burning fossil fuels.

examples.japanese: {炭素排出|たんそはいしゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炭素排出|たんそはいしゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Carbon emissions from factories have become a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2050⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{炭素排出|たんそはいしゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実質|じっしつ}→実質：12282_jisshitsu⟧⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げている→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧。
examples.english: Japan has set a goal of achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{炭素|たんそ}→炭素：06583_tanso⟧ (carbon) + ⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧ (emission; discharge). Frequently appears in news and policy discussions about climate change. The longer form {二酸化炭素排出|にさんかたんそはいしゅつ} (carbon dioxide emissions) is technically more precise, but {炭素排出|たんそはいしゅつ} is the common shorthand.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炭素排出|たんそはいしゅつ}{量|りょう}: amount of carbon emissions
- {炭素排出|たんそはいしゅつ}⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧: carbon emission reduction
- {炭素排出|たんそはいしゅつ}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧: zero carbon emissions
- {炭素排出|たんそはいしゅつ}⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧: carbon emission regulations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{温室効果ガス|おんしつこうかがす}→温室効果ガス：24833_onshitsukoukagasu⟧: greenhouse gases — a broader category that includes carbon dioxide and other heat-trapping gases
- ⟦{脱炭素|だつたんそ}→脱炭素：06410_datsutanso⟧: decarbonization — the process of reducing carbon emissions, often used in policy contexts
- ⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧: emission; discharge — the general term for releasing substances, not limited to carbon
